note: Quantization options with size + quality trade-offs, distilled from recipe-factory/TRIED-OPTIONS-LEDGER.md section 7. Each option declares its baseline: 'fp4-packed' factors are relative to an FP4-shipped checkpoint budget (e.g. DeepSeek-V4.1 MXFP4); 'bf16' factors are relative to a bf16 checkpoint budget (most HuggingFace models). The calculator warns on a budget/quant baseline mismatch. Measured values are marked; published references are marked.

mxfp4.label: MXFP4 (checkpoint as shipped)
mxfp4.quality_delta: baseline (the model was trained on it)
mxfp4.kernel_reality: native CUTLASS SM120 grouped GEMM, decode at 93% of copy ceiling (measured E13); no re-quantization step exists that beats the checkpoint as shipped

nvfp4.label: NVFP4 re-quantization
nvfp4.quality_delta: re-quantized from the shipped weights; not measured as a quality delta on this model
nvfp4.kernel_reality: cuBLAS/CUTLASS W4A4 paths, better engine support than MXFP4; measured 15.8 GiB LARGER than MXFP4 for V4.1-Flash (block-16 UE4M3 scales)

fp8-dense.label: FP8 dense parts (W8A8), experts untouched
fp8-dense.quality_delta: FP8 dense GEMMs measured quality-neutral on this project (E20 shipped)
fp8-dense.kernel_reality: dense FP8 GEMMs are the measured hot spot (57% of the step, E20 2.26x C1); doubling dense bytes is usually a VRAM purchase with a speed gain

exl3.label: EXL3 2.9-3.0 bpw (trellis)
exl3.quality_delta: unknown on FP4-trained experts (never gated here)
exl3.kernel_reality: no SM120 MoE kernel in vLLM/SGLang; bespoke forks only (GLM-5.3 needed a custom fork); TensorFold rejected as engine on this hardware
exl3.source: recipe-factory/TRIED-OPTIONS-LEDGER.md section 7 (sub-4-bit experts row); recipe-factory/METHODOLOGY.md section 5.3

gguf-q4_k_m.label: GGUF Q4_K_M (llama.cpp)
gguf-q4_k_m.quality_delta: published llama.cpp ladder numbers; per-model quality not gated
gguf-q4_k_m.kernel_reality: llama.cpp CPU+GPU offload with -ot expert offload; published size 18.56 GB for Qwen3-30B-A3B (61 GB bf16 -> factor 0.307)

gguf-q3_k_m.label: GGUF Q3_K_M (llama.cpp)
gguf-q3_k_m.quality_delta: aggressive; approximate factor (3 bpw / 16 bpw + block scales)
gguf-q3_k_m.source: approx. from bpw/16; published Qwen3-30B-A3B sizes anchor Q4/Q5/Q6/Q8

gguf-q2_k.label: GGUF Q2_K (llama.cpp)
gguf-q2_k.quality_delta: very aggressive; use only for exploratory offload fits
